topic: Defining traffic metrics and factor implementation
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed two main topics: defining the correct term for total traffic and implementing a new city media factor. Regarding traffic, it was confirmed that "Total Traffic Screens" is the preferred terminology over "Total Traffic Bulk." For the new city media factor (changing from 3.6 to 5.5), it was decided that the change would only affect Ocean data. Furthermore, the implementation of this new factor will be limited to staging environments and will not alter historical data.
decisions: Total Traffic Screens is the correct term for "large" total traffic.
The new city media factor (5.5) will only impact Ocean data.
The new factor implementation must be restricted to staging environments and should not change historical records.
